author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep protocol/plumbing-level interfaces (e.g. pluggable backend abstractions) out of the core public API package; put them in the protocol layer.
fix_shape: move the backend interface down into the protocol package rather than the core API package.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When renaming a concept across the codebase, rename module/class/identifier names consistently; where an old term must persist (e.g. for storage compatibility) mark it explicitly with a comment instead of silently mixing old and new terminology.
fix_shape: rename the module/class to the new term and leave a TODO explaining any persisted field that must keep the old name.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the existing branded/domain type instead of a raw primitive for a field that represents that domain concept.
fix_shape: change the field's type from a raw string to the existing branded type (e.g. SpaceId).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a declarative plan/schema module free of executable implementation logic; put the implementation in the executor that consumes the plan.
fix_shape: move the runtime/execution logic out of the plan module and into the executor.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefix an internal-implementation brand/tag key with the module's fully-qualified path to avoid collisions with similarly named brand keys elsewhere.
fix_shape: namespace the brand string with the package/module path.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove a special-purpose API once a more general one already covers its behavior, rather than keeping both.
fix_shape: delete the narrower function and route its use through the general one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Type dynamic/aggregate field names against the underlying schema rather than leaving them as unconstrained strings.
fix_shape: constrain the field-name type parameter to keys of the source type.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Extract a repeated or inline complex conditional/generic type into a named type alias for readability.
fix_shape: factor the inline conditional type out into a named exported type.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove a module that exists only to support a dependency or subsystem that has since been removed.
fix_shape: delete the module once the supporting dependency is confirmed gone.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Model a value whose fields vary by kind as a discriminated/tagged union, not a single struct with optional fields that are only meaningful for some kinds.
fix_shape: split the struct into a tagged union with one variant per kind.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Break a large inline Effect Layer construction into individual, focused layers rather than one monolithic layer.
fix_shape: split the layer body into several smaller named layers and compose them.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Define Effect layers as module-level values rather than nesting their construction inside a function closure, so they compose flatly and can be reused independently.
fix_shape: hoist the sub-layer definitions to the top of the module.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Collapse multiple conditional branches that each return a variant of the same composition into a single expression using the type's identity/empty element.
fix_shape: replace the if/else branches with a ternary using the empty/identity value as the fallback.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Represent a service implementation as an Effect Tag + Layer, not a plain class instantiated ad hoc, so it composes into the layer stack like the rest of the services.
fix_shape: convert the class's service implementations into Tag+Layer pairs and provide them in the stack.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Push a component's open/close lifecycle logic down into that component's own layer/resource rather than centralizing all lifecycle steps in one orchestrator.
fix_shape: move each component's open/close code into its own layer, keeping the orchestrator's open/close minimal.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Define Effect layers as module-level values rather than nesting their construction inside a function closure, so they compose flatly and can be reused independently.
fix_shape: hoist the sub-layer definitions to the top of the module.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't explicitly provide/wire a dependency that Effect's layer composition already resolves automatically.
fix_shape: remove the redundant explicit provide and let the layer graph resolve it.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Depend on the specific fine-grained service tag a component needs rather than pulling it off a large aggregate/facade object.
fix_shape: inject the individual service's own tag instead of reaching through the aggregate service context.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Use the concurrency/synchronization idiom already established in the codebase rather than introducing a new, unprecedented pattern for the same problem.
fix_shape: rewrite the workaround using the codebase's existing locking primitive instead of the novel pattern.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove helper functions that are no longer used or add no value over inlining.
fix_shape: delete the unused/trivial helpers.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Make a consumer depend only on the specific components it actually needs, not an entire legacy aggregate object.
fix_shape: narrow the consumer's dependency to the individual services it uses.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Collapse multiple conditional branches that each return a variant of the same composition into a single expression using the type's identity/empty element.
fix_shape: use Layer.empty as the identity branch instead of a separate conditional path.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Merge a module that has shrunk to near triviality into the sibling module it exists to support, rather than keeping a near-empty file around.
fix_shape: fold the small file's contents into its sibling module and delete the file.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Represent an identifier as its semantic type (e.g. URI) rather than a plain string when the domain already has such a type.
fix_shape: change the field's type from string to the appropriate semantic type.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the shared serialized-error type from the protocols package to represent an error across a process/RPC boundary, rather than a bespoke message string field.
fix_shape: replace the ad hoc message field with the shared SerializedError type.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Construct a service as the direct value its Effect Tag resolves to, rather than wrapping it in an extra Layer indirection when the tag can hold the value directly.
fix_shape: have the tag's layer return the value itself instead of an intermediate wrapper layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Wrap only the specific Promise-returning call in Effect.promise, not an entire block of otherwise-synchronous logic.
fix_shape: narrow the Effect.promise wrapper to the individual async call sites.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use true ES #private class fields consistently rather than mixing them with TypeScript `private`/underscore-prefixed fields in the same class.
fix_shape: convert the remaining private-by-convention fields to true #private fields.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Wrap a callback-based timer (setTimeout) in Effect.async (or use Effect.sleep) instead of using it directly inside Effect code.
fix_shape: replace the raw setTimeout callback with Effect.async/Effect.sleep.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't introduce a separate service for a concern that spans other services; add the verbs to each owning service instead.
fix_shape: delete the cross-cutting service and move each verb onto the service that owns that data.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Wrap only the specific Promise-returning call in Effect.promise, not an entire block of otherwise-synchronous logic.
fix_shape: narrow the Effect.promise wrapper to the individual async call sites.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Extract an inline block of probing/detection logic into a named function rather than leaving it inline.
fix_shape: factor the inline probe into its own named function.
